description: Product updates, news, plans, and social pointers.

items.title: CuNi 0.1.8 — write once, print many languages
items.body: CuNi now emits a catalog of coding languages from one source. Python, Go, and JavaScript still have to print the same thing, or the compiler refuses. Studio is free. Closed-app exception $490/year.
